title: VERY LOUD FAHHH
blurb: VERY LOUD FAHHH — the most-played sound on entire soundboards, and a legitimate hearing hazard. The 'fahh' scream is meme culture's purest expression of shock, and this version removes any volume ceiling. It's the sound for jump scares, sudden realisations, and destroying the audio of anyone who trusted you with an unmuted mic.
origin: The maximum-volume edition of the viral 'fahh' scream.
